description: Posts, comments, and error records scraped from TeamBlind. Each row carries a `recordType` field — `post` for thread bodies, `comment` for reply bodies, `error` for fetch / login-wall failures.

records.description: Dataset of all scraped posts and comments. Each record begins with `recordType` (post / comment / error), followed by entity fields (id, alias, title, content, author, timestamps, counts, url) and a `scrapedAt` ISO timestamp.
records.title: TeamBlind records
